description: Evidence was provided to someone. Either named pieces were asked for, and the record says which were provided; or a whole session was provided, and the record says which of its content was withheld.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

excluding.description: What of the session was withheld, by reference: a record left out whole, or content left out of a record that was provided. Present with `scope` even when empty, so that nothing withheld is told apart from nothing said.

items.description: An exact reference to content, a record or a Core event.

policy.description: One evaluation of one exact policy against exact inputs.
